title: Names, Not Numbers

Before it ships: (1) Dillon reads it as himself and keeps or cuts every first-person claim. (2) The inline [source: ...] tags and the frontmatter sources list carry client folder names (kimberly-james-bridal, omega-landscaping, onsite-concrete-landscape, fagan-painting, nexla, and others); strip or convert them to numbered endnotes before anything leaves the building, because the body text is anonymized and the tags are not. (3) No client is named in the body; if Mac wants any story named, permission must be on file first. (4) The free 15-minute snapshot is the only ask and is described per PLAN.md; confirm it exists as a real page or intake path before the last section points anyone at it.
